༄༅/ /phyag 'tshal dri med zla rgyas bzhugs/rin chen shog 'dra/ /

tei:div.tei:p: rin chen shog 'dra/ / āoṃ badzra gu ru padma ( < a > siddhi ) si ti āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ye shes gang chen mtsho'i rgya mtsho las lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin rgyal sras chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ /mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bde chen yon tan 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma mchog /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid/ /zhi dang khro tshul dpag med ston/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal po'i 'phrin las dpag med las/ / rang byung rig 'dzin kun gyi gtso/ /lha mi'i ston pa bla na med/ /dga' rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs shing*/ /sku dang 'phrin las bsam yas kyi/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /shrī sidha la phyag 'tshal/ bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul las/ /rang byung ge sar padma'i steng*/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /ngo bo ye nas kun tu bzang*/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje padma sku sprul pa/ /shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsum mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gdul bya'i re ba rnam skong zhing*/ / mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /padma rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /ji snyed ji bzhin thams cad mkhyen/ /sna tshogs chos kyi rnga sgra yis/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /blo ldan mchog sred la phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gangs ri las/ /rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang brnyes/ /dpag med 'khor ba'i tshogs nang na/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrogs la phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i char sprin rol pa las/ /phan bde'i glog phreng char 'bebs shing*/

/'gro blo'i phun tshogs rgyas mdzad pa/ /padma saṃ bha la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gsung rab padma rgyas mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba'i lam yangs dkar por mdzad/ /nyi ma 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam sprul drag pos 'dul ba la/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhing*/ /lha srin gdug pa tshar gcod pa'i/ /rdo rje gro lod la phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin phung las/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing*/ /bde chen rgyal ba mnyes mdzad yum/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa/ / zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ / 'di nas/ sku gsum snying po'i don rtogs shing*/ /mkhyen brtse'i rol pa dpag yas kyis/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang ston mdzad pa/ /sprul sku legs ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag shākya'i sras/ /bslab gsum rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing*/ /theg gsum snying po'i don rtogs pa/ /shanta de ba la phyag 'tshal/ /mdo rgyud shes bya'i gnas la mkhas/ /bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /a ti gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i pha/ /chos kyi grags pa la phyag 'tshal/ /grub thob rje yi rgyud par 'khrungs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /nyi ma 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa thob/ /sku lnga yongs rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /byang sems chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*/ /'gro ba'i gnyen mchog sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /gu ru'i sprul pa gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ / 'di yan kha bskang*/ /chos dbyings bde chen nam mkha'i klaung*/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sprin 'phro ba/ / rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi yum/

/rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /rang nyid chos dbyings rol pa las/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rnam 'phrul gyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las mdzad pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rig 'dzin dang*/ /bde gshegs tshogs dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho dang*/ /mchod 'os kun la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran gyis/ /grangs dang mnyam pa'i lus sprul te/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams yongs bkang ste/ /bla med bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mchod 'os rnams la mchod par bgyi/ /thog ma med nas lus dang ngag /yid kyis sdig pa'i las bgyis pa/ /de kun rab tu 'gyod sems kyis/ /mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /shes dang mi spang dang du blang*/ /sgrub dang khas blangs la sogs pa/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las/ /'gal zhing nyams pa so sor bshags/ /bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum gyi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*/ /'gro ba'i khams dang mos pa dang*/ /blo yi rim pa ji bzhin du/ /theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /deng nas srid pa ma stongs bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas/ /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul dpag yas kyi/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis mdzad par gsol/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba kun/ /ma lus blo yis gcig bsdus nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /dus gsum srid pa'i sems can kun/ /rdo rje theg la rab bzhugs nas/ /gnyis med ye shes don rtogs nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas shog /rnam smin 'byung ba'i lus 'di yang*/ /mngon sum 'od gsal bsgoms pa yis/ /rang dengs 'od kyi phung po ru/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par shog /phyogs mtha' gtug pa'i sems can kun/ /bde thob sdug bsngal kun bral te/

/dam pa rnams las chos thob nas/ /thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /bdag kyang deng nas dus kun tu/ /zab mo'i chos rnams 'dzin pa dang*/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /'gro kun ma lus sgrol par shog /bdag gi bde ba'i cha shas kyis/ /sems can rnams ni nyer 'tsho zhing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal ma lus kun/ /bdag la smin nas grol bar shog /bdag gi brtsams pa thams cad kun/ /sems can don las ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan du rdul tsam mi dmigs pas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis 'grub par shog /bar do'i yul la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal rang ngo shes pa yis/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la mthar phyin nas/ /sems can kun don 'grub par shog /ye shes dag pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /srid pa'i bar do mi mthong zhing*/ /phyogs bcu rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing*/ /bgrod nas 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /padma'i mtsho la bung ba ltar/ /'gro la las 'brel yongs stsal te/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer gyis/ / skal ldan snang ba 'byed par shog /bdag blo'i dge legs phun tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa kun 'grub ste/ /srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas par/ /phyam cig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi phyag 'tshal dri med zla rgyas zhes bya ba/ o rgyan padma'i thugs kyi 'od zer blo'i padmor reg pas 'dzum par byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dri med 'od zer gyi rjes su sku gsum snying po zhes pa nas dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i bar kha bskang byas pa zhig yin 'dra bas nges par mdzod// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)phyag 'tshal dri med zla rgyas/ -PAGE 20--PAGE 21--PAGE 17-
